context: Whole family writes new year postcards together at the dining table.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今年も、年賀状の季節ね。
lines.en: It's postcard season again this year, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, almost wistful opening. Tender tone, no rush. She's noticing the ritual as much as the season. Soft trailing attention at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 皆、ようけ書かなあかんな。
lines.en: Man, everyone's got a bunch to write.
lines.style: Generous Kansai warmth, good-natured complaint. Slight chuckle underneath. Not tired, just pleasantly overwhelmed. The tone of someone who loves the chaos.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: デザイン、考えるの楽しい!
lines.en: I love thinking about the designs!
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. Sharp attack on the opening. Quick pace, genuine delight. The kind of energy that expects you to be excited with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I want to write one too!
lines.style: Small, sincere urgency. Not demanding — eager to join in. Soft but clear. The quietness of a younger child asking to be part of something he sees matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Let's write them carefully, shall we.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, not command. Warm authority of a mother who expects care without demanding perfection. Slight smile in the voice. Settling, grounding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Weight to each word — this matters to him. Fond memory underneath. Quiet conviction without lecturing. Kansai warmth in the cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 心、こめて伝えましょうね。
lines.en: Let's put our hearts into what we write, okay.
lines.style: Tender, sincere. She means this. Soft opening, steady through the middle, slight emphasis on 「心」moment. Not sentimental — genuine. Warm, close proximity in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 幸せな一年、願って書く。
lines.en: Writing them with wishes for a happy year.
lines.style: Pride mixed with contentment. Generous Kansai warmth, full voice. He's not just describing the action — he's savoring it. Slight lift at the end, like he's pleased with the whole picture.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm writing lots and lots of postcards to my friends!
lines.style: Unrestrained brightness, rapid-fire delivery. Attack hard on the opening. Energy and certainty — she knows exactly what she's doing. Infectious, inclusive tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Dad, your writing is really good!
lines.style: Genuine admiration, quiet and observant. Not performing — truly noticing. Soft, sincere tone. The small voice of a child who looks up. No artifice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、賑やかでええわね。
lines.en: Heh, it's nice and lively, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm contentment, affectionate amusement. Small laugh at the opening. Relaxed, watching-fondly tone. She's pleased with her family. No edge, just love.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 家族、こうやって書くのも、伝統や。
lines.en: Writing like this as a family — it's a tradition, isn't it.
lines.style: Philosophical, gently musing. Slow pace, thoughtful. He's seeing the moment clearly — past and future in it. Quiet wisdom, no preaching. Warm Kansai cadence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 皆で、ええ年、迎えましょう。
lines.en: Let's all welcome in a good year together.
lines.style: Tender, hopeful closing. Gathering tone — inviting everyone in. Warm, steady voice. She's anchoring the moment, making it matter. Slight softness at the end, like a wish.
